items.title: Tenbrugge
items.content: A professional WordPress website for Ten Bruggen that presents financial and accountancy services in a clear, trustworthy and accessible way. The website combines strong structure, responsive design and direct contact options to help visitors quickly find the right expertise.
items.excerpt: For Ten Bruggen, I created a modern and responsive WordPress website focused on clarity, credibility and conversion. Complex financial services were translated into an easy-to-navigate structure with clear service pages, strong calls to action and integrated appointment booking. The result is a professional website that supports both the brand and the customer journey.

items.title: Sanatolia
items.content: Cultural WordPress website for Stichting Sanatolia, bringing courses, events, ticket sales and information about art and culture together in one clear online platform.
items.excerpt: A clear and accessible WordPress platform that combines culture, education and events while helping visitors quickly find activities, courses and ways to participate.

items.title: Werkenbijefe
items.content: A recruitment-focused WordPress website that brings a large vacancy library, employer positioning, sector information, reviews and application routes into one candidate journey. The site supports both broad vacancy discovery and detailed role pages with clear application actions.
items.excerpt: Werken bij EFE connects vacancy discovery, sector context, employer positioning, reviews and clear application routes.

items.title: RBMB
items.content: A WooCommerce webshop for RBMB that turns a broad professional building-material catalogue into a clearer shopping structure across categories, products and next-step actions. The work focuses on product discovery, responsive presentation and keeping purchase or contact routes easy to find.
items.excerpt: Building-material webshop where category hierarchy leads customers from a broad assortment to product detail, purchase or advice.

items.title: Enspect
items.content: Enspect separates SCIOS Scope, NEN, thermography and engineering services before adding practical process detail and trust information. Technical explanations remain readable while quote access stays visible for business customers.
items.excerpt: Technical inspection site separating SCIOS, NEN, thermography and engineering services, supported by process detail, trust content and quote access.

items.title: Leeuwbeveiliging
items.content: Professional security services, business credibility and direct contact lead the Leeuw Beveiliging WordPress site. The experience helps business customers understand the company's security expertise and move toward the relevant service or enquiry.
items.excerpt: Security-services WordPress site combining business credibility with a straightforward enquiry route.

items.title: Doctorcura
items.content: Doctorcura has to keep treatment discovery, product information, medical-process steps and FAQs understandable within the same healthcare platform. The WordPress structure breaks this information into clear next steps that remain readable on desktop and mobile.
items.excerpt: Healthcare WordPress project that separates treatment information, FAQs and medical-process steps into a responsive sequence of next actions.

items.title: Koelcellenbouw
items.content: Custom cold rooms, freezer rooms, cleanrooms and turnkey projects define Koelcellenbouw's specialist B2B offer. The WordPress structure explains those technical capabilities for companies evaluating a project, with quote and contact access attached to each service area.
items.excerpt: Custom cold rooms, freezer rooms and related technical projects sit within dedicated service and quotation paths at Koelcellenbouw.

items.title: Astenadvies
items.content: Financial-advice choices are kept concise at Astenadvies so visitors can compare service areas and move toward a conversation.
items.excerpt: Astenadvies separates financial-advice service areas, trust information and the path into an initial advice conversation.

items.title: Zeninspec
items.content: ZEN Inspection serves international inspection, testing and certification work across laboratory, cargo, marine and other contexts. The site separates those service areas while keeping accreditation, sector expertise and quote access available to technical decision-makers.
items.excerpt: Inspection and certification site with distinct technical service areas, sector context, accreditation proof and direct quote access.

items.title: Schipholparkeren
items.content: Schipholparkeren centers the website around the booking journey while keeping parking options and extra services easy to compare. Visitors can enter arrival and return details, choose between options such as valet and comfort parking, and review services including charging, washing and refuelling before reserving.
items.excerpt: Parking-booking flow built around arrival and return dates, parking choices and add-ons such as charging, washing and refuelling.

items.title: Casareno
items.content: Casareno's construction and renovation site uses completed projects and a five-step working process to frame services such as renovation, new-build work, bathrooms, floors, doors and finishing. Advice actions follow that context rather than competing with the project evidence.
items.excerpt: Project evidence and the five-step method give prospective renovation clients context before they move into an advice conversation.

items.title: Pastrycompany
items.content: Pastrycompany connects its WooCommerce shop with catering and event-service content on the same site. Product discovery, special offers, ordering, reviews, event services and contact information are structured so visitors can move between buying food online and planning a larger occasion.
items.excerpt: Pastrycompany combines online product ordering with catering services, reviews, location information and enquiry options.

items.title: Ourwp
items.content: Ourwp presents virtual offices and business-address services in a WordPress journey designed for entrepreneurs. The public website explains KvK registration addresses, post handling, scan services and package options while giving customers direct routes to sign up, contact the team or access their account.
items.excerpt: Virtual-office site explaining KvK registration addresses, post handling, scan services and packages before signup or account access.

items.title: Byderma
items.content: A WordPress and WooCommerce beauty platform that brings treatments, a large product catalogue, member benefits, booking and shopping into one consistent experience. On smaller screens, the same separation between treatment, shopping and booking remains easy to recognize and use.
items.excerpt: Task separation drives the beauty platform: discovery, appointments and ecommerce remain distinct while visitors can switch between them without losing context.

items.title: Bluecenter
items.content: Treatment discovery, pricing, practical FAQs and appointment booking are connected across Bluecenter's broad beauty offer. Visitors can move from categories such as facial treatments, PMU, massage or laser hair removal to the information they need before booking.
items.excerpt: Beauty and treatment site that links treatment categories and pricing to practical FAQs and direct appointment booking.

items.title: Mdvinstallaties
items.content: MDV Installaties presents electrical work, renovations, service and maintenance, and locksmith services through a clear WordPress structure. Planned projects and urgent service needs are separated so visitors can identify the right type of support and contact the company without unnecessary steps.
items.excerpt: MDV Installaties brings electrical work, renovations, maintenance and locksmith support into distinct enquiry routes.

items.title: Ckbouw
items.content: CK Bouw has distinct audiences to serve: project clients, employers and professionals looking for work. Construction and service content and vacancies branch into audience-specific actions while shared brand material keeps the organisation recognisable across both sides.
items.excerpt: Construction and recruitment site separating project capability from vacancies and staffing actions for clients, candidates and employers.

items.title: Prolineafbouw
items.content: Latex spraying, system ceilings and walls, metal-stud work, plastering and painting are separated into a service-led WordPress offer for Proline Afbouw. Project examples, reviews and a quotation route give prospective customers practical context before they enquire.
items.excerpt: Finishing-services site with separate pages for latex spraying, ceilings and walls, metal-stud work, plastering and painting, supported by projects, reviews and quote access.

items.title: Connectwerk
items.content: Vacancy browsing and candidate registration form one branch of Connectwerk; employer staffing information forms the other. Sector-focused content supports both branches without mixing their primary actions.
items.excerpt: Connectwerk keeps candidate and employer routes separate while connecting vacancies, registration and staffing information.
